monitoredTrends.title: Supabase Transaction Pooler vs Direct Connections: Fixing Serverless Disk IO & Swap Throttling
monitoredTrends.whyItConverts: Engineering teams running Vercel or AWS Lambda against managed PostgreSQL frequently hit connection exhaustion and Disk IO throttling under burst traffic. Port 6543 transaction pooling with singleton clients eliminates 504 outages.
relatedQueries: Session vs Transaction Pooler trade-offs on Port 6543
Singleton pool client architecture and prepared-statement rules
SWR caching and query indexing to cut database CPU by 45%

monitoredTrends.title: Kubernetes GPU Autoscaling & Spot Instance FinOps for Production ML Inference
monitoredTrends.whyItConverts: Always-on GPU clusters drain cloud budgets during off-peak hours. Splitting synchronous quantized ONNX inference from spot-backed batch retraining cuts monthly ML infrastructure costs by nearly 50%.
relatedQueries: KEDA queue-depth scaling with fast-booting ONNX containers
Checkpointed training DAGs on fault-tolerant spot node pools
Shadow traffic mirroring and 3-second canary rollbacks

monitoredTrends.title: Strangler Fig Legacy Modernization: Migrating Monolithic ERPs Without Business Downtime
